messages.author: 5b53730f01b0a96a
messages.subject: Filtering missing data "-"
parts:
Dear All:
Is there a way to filter missing data "-" for SilicoDArT, in which following Metadata information from DArT technology, its states calls with non-zero counts, but too low counts to score confidently as "1" (often representing heterozygotes). 
It would be great that could include threshold options (example threshold = 0.90, 0.50 or 0.25)?
Thanks in advance for your help.

Peco

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: Filtering missing data "-"
parts:
Hi Peco,

Package dartR is designed to pick up from the 2Row, 1Row and SilicoDArT files generated by Diversity Arrays Technology. We do not delve back past that boundary, and so do not have the information required to include threshold options. You could request Diversity Arrays Technology to adjust the threshold for calling a tag presence or absence.

As for filtering the SilicoDArT for missing values, we have not completed addition of scripts to handle tag presence/absence data. I have attached two scripts that will be in the rebuild after next.

Sorry I could not be of more help.

A
